page.overview:
Who is Gereth?

Gereth was one of the Elves who aided the flight of Evranin from Artanor (the place which would later become Doriath) during the years following the battles between Elves and the Nauglath. They bore the Necklace of the Dwarves away from the sons of Fëanor.

Gereth and Evranin are not mentioned in the final story of the Necklace of the Dwarves in The Silmarillion.
